amuletOverride.title: Amulet Override
amuletOverride.desc: Specifies if the amulet should override the Wither Storm's targeting.

applicationDelay.title: Application Delay
applicationDelay.desc: Specifies the amount of time in seconds high immunity mobs (players) must be infected in order to be applied the wither sickness effect Range: 12 ~ 1200

applicationDelayModifierMax.title: Application Delay Modifier Max
applicationDelayModifierMax.desc: High immunity mobs (players) will be assigned a random application delay modifier that will change the application delay. This value will set the maximum potential limit for that modifier, in seconds. Range: 12 ~ 1200

asyncBufferBuilders.title: Async Buffer Builders
asyncBufferBuilders.desc: Builds instanced vertex buffers off thread to help reduce stuttering. It is only recommended to disable this if facing compatibility issues.

attackableWhenNotVulnerable.title: Attackable When Not Vulnerable
attackableWhenNotVulnerable.desc: Specifies if the Withered Symbiont can be attacked from behind if it's not vulnerable.

autoSpawnTime.title: Auto Spawn Time
autoSpawnTime.desc: Specifies the amount of time (in minutes) required for the Wither Storm to automatically spawn, if enabled. Range: 0 ~ 120

autoSpawnWitherStorm.title: Auto Spawn Wither Storm
autoSpawnWitherStorm.desc: Specifies if the Wither Storm should automatically be spawned upon world creation.

blindingEffects.title: Blinding Effects
blindingEffects.desc: Specifies whether or not a white overlay should cover the screen during certain events.

blockClusterPullSpeedModifier.title: Block Cluster Pull Speed Modifier
blockClusterPullSpeedModifier.desc: Modifies the Wither Storm's block cluster pull speed by multiplying the default speed with this value. Range: 0.1 ~ 10.0

blockClusterRendering.title: Block Cluster Rendering
blockClusterRendering.desc: Toggles the rendering of Block Clusters.

blockClustersDropItems.title: Block Clusters Drop Items
blockClustersDropItems.desc: Toggle to enable/disable drops from Block Clusters. NOTE: Enabling this feature can cause world lag

boatingForTooLongDistractions.title: Boating For Too Long Distractions
boatingForTooLongDistractions.desc: Specifies if the Wither Storm should get distracted when a player boats across water for too long. Used to prevent specific scenarios where the Wither Storm is chasing players but it can't quite keep up.

boatingForTooLongSeconds.title: Boating For Too Long Seconds
boatingForTooLongSeconds.desc: The amount of time a player needs to be boating until the Wither Storm will become distracted. Range: 30 ~ 300

bookDropsInInventory.title: Book Drops In Inventory
bookDropsInInventory.desc: If multiple players are near the Withered Symbiont, the command block book will automatically drop into the inventory of the player the Symbiont was spawned for, if they are nearby and have inventory space.

bowelsFallResistance.title: Bowels Fall Resistance
bowelsFallResistance.desc: Specifies if max strength damange resistance should be given to the player when falling out of the bowels, to mitigate fall damage.

cameraShakeEffects.title: Camera Shake Effects
cameraShakeEffects.desc: Specifies whether or not camera shake effects should be used.

canAttackHeads.title: Can Attack Heads
canAttackHeads.desc: Specifies if the Wither Storm's heads can be attacked.

canClustersSpiralCounterClockwise.title: Can Clusters Spiral Counter Clockwise
canClustersSpiralCounterClockwise.desc: Specifies if block clusters can have a chance to spiral counter clockwise when being consumed by the Wither Storm.

canPickupMobClusters.title: Can Pick Up Mob Clusters
canPickupMobClusters.desc: Specifies if the Wither Storm's tractor beams can pull in multiple mobs at once that interesect the beam.

canSummonSymbiont.title: Can Summon Symbiont
canSummonSymbiont.desc: Specifies if the Wither Storm can summon the Withered Symbiont.

catchFireFuseTicks.title: Catch Fire Fuse Ticks
catchFireFuseTicks.desc: If the formidibomb is manually set on fire the fuse tick count will be set to this value, if the original fuse is greater than this value. Range: 1 ~ 12000

caveRumbleIntensity.title: Cave Rumble Intensity
caveRumbleIntensity.desc: Higher values makes cave rumbles more 'intense,' and makes more dripstone and glowberries fall. Range: 0.0 ~ 1.0

caveRumbleIntervalMax.title: Cave Rumble Interval Maximum
caveRumbleIntervalMax.desc: Specifies the maximum interval possible (in seconds) between cave rumbles. Range: 5 ~ 1800

caveRumbleIntervalMin.title: Cave Rumble Interval Minimum
caveRumbleIntervalMin.desc: Specifies the minimum interval possible (in seconds) between cave rumbles. Range: 5 ~ 1800

caveRumbles.title: Cave Rumbles
caveRumbles.desc: Specifies if the screen should shake and other various cave rumble effects should occur when underground and near the Storm.

caveRumblesMessWithRedstone.title: Cave Rumbles Mess With Redstone
caveRumblesMessWithRedstone.desc: Specifies if cave rumbles should mess with redstone type blocks.

chanceForExtendedRumbles.title: Chance For Extended Rumbles
chanceForExtendedRumbles.desc: Specifies if a random chance for extended cave rumbles to occur should be possible.

chaseOnPhaseChange.title: Chase On Phase Change
chaseOnPhaseChange.desc: Specifies if the Wither Storm should accelerate when it evolves into the next phase..

chasingFlyingSpeed.title: Chasing Flying Speed
chasingFlyingSpeed.desc: Specifies a modifier value of Target Stationary Flying Speed attribute. The higher the value, the faster the Wither Storm will go when its ultimate target is stationary Range: 0.01 ~ 1.0

chromaticAberration.title: Chromatic Aberration
chromaticAberration.desc: Toggle to enable/disable the chromatic aberration effect.

chunkLoadingRadius.title: Chunk Loading Radius
chunkLoadingRadius.desc: Specifies the chunk loading radius for the Wither Storm Range: 6 ~ 32

clusterPickupInterval.title: Cluster Pickup Interval
clusterPickupInterval.desc: Alters the interval (in ticks) of picking up block clusters for the destroyer phases (phase 4 - 5). NOTE: This value changes the evolution speed of the Wither Storm significantly. Range: 10 ~ 80

clusterSizeModifier.title: Block Cluster Size Modifier
clusterSizeModifier.desc: Increases the radius of block clusters linearly by this amount. NOTE: Greatly impacts the Wither Storm's evolution rate. Greater values also lead to worse performance!. Range: 0 ~ 16

clustersRemoveItems.title: Block Clusters Remove Items
clustersRemoveItems.desc: Specifies if Block Clusters should remove non-important items in its path. NOTE: Disabling can cause major lag.

constantBlackhole.title: Constant Blackhole
constantBlackhole.desc: CAUTION THIS WILL BE EXTREMELY LAGGY, THIS SETS THE WITHER STORM TO HAVE NO SMALL CLUSTER COOLDOWN.

convertFallingBlocks.title: Convert Falling Blocks
convertFallingBlocks.desc: Specifies if the Wither Storm should convert falling blocks into clusters (NOTE: This can be very laggy and cause the Wither Storm to evolve fast!).

craftFuseTicks.title: Craft Fuse Ticks
craftFuseTicks.desc: Specifies the fuse in ticks that count down to the formidibomb's explosion. The fuse is set when the block is crafted. Range: 1 ~ 12000

crossbowsSupportEnderPearls.title: Crossbows Support Ender Pearls
crossbowsSupportEnderPearls.desc: Specifies if crossbows should be able to also shoot ender pearls. Disable if facing compatibility issues.

cureDelay.title: Cure Delay
cureDelay.desc: Specifies the delay, in seconds, before high immunity mobs (players) are cured of wither sickness Range: 12 ~ 1200

cureDelayModifierMax.title: Cure Delay Modifier Max
cureDelayModifierMax.desc: High immunity mobs (players) will be assigned a random cure delay modifier that will change the cure delay. This value will set the maximum potential limit for that modifier, in seconds. Range: 12 ~ 1200

customPanorama.title: Custom Panorama
customPanorama.desc: Toggles the custom main menu panorama added by the mod.

devourerClusterPickupInterval.title: Devourer Cluster Pick Up Interval
devourerClusterPickupInterval.desc: Alters the interval (in ticks) of picking up block clusters for the devourer phases (phase 6+). NOTE: This value changes the evolution speed of the Wither Storm significantly. Range: 10 ~ 80

distanceMultiplier.title: Target Stationary Distance Multiplier
distanceMultiplier.desc: Specifies if the Wither Storm should use this value as a multiplier when calculating the time in ticks it takes for it to start accelerating, when its ultimate target is stationary. Range: 0.1 ~ 24.0

distantFog.title: Distant Fog
distantFog.desc: Specifies if fog should be applied to Wither Storms being rendered from a distance.

distantRenderer.title: Distant Renderer
distantRenderer.desc: The distant renderer allows for the Wither Storm to be rendered from much greater distances than what vanilla allows. Disable if you're facing issues with it.

distractionTimeMinutes.title: Distraction Time
distractionTimeMinutes.desc: Specifies the time in minutes that the Wither Storm should be distracted for, plus some random modifying and more. Range: 1 ~ 25

distractionWaitTime.title: Distraction Wait Time
distractionWaitTime.desc: For when the Wither Storm needs to wait to become distracted, this value (in minutes) will specifiy the wait time, plus a random modifier. Range: 1 ~ 20

dropInterval.title: Drop Interval
dropInterval.desc: Specifies the interval for when the formidibomb will drop out of its inventory (if enabled). This value divides the crafted fuse ticks to get the interval (e.x. 12000 / 4 = 3000). Range: 1 ~ 8

dynamicFlyingHeight.title: Dynamic Flying Height
dynamicFlyingHeight.desc: Makes the Wither Storm randomly adjust it's flying height itself between 40 and 80.

dynamicFlyingHeightTime.title: Dynamic Flying Height Time
dynamicFlyingHeightTime.desc: The time (in seconds) that the Wither Storm should take before adjusting it's dynamic flying height. Range: 15 ~ 1200

earRingingEffects.title: Ear Ringing Effects
earRingingEffects.desc: Turn off to disable the ear ringing effects used in the mod.

endOfPhaseFiveBombableExclusively.title: End Of Phase Five Formidibombable Exclusively
endOfPhaseFiveBombableExclusively.desc: Specifies if only the end of phase five can be formidibombed, instead of all of phase 5.

evolutionAttributeModifier.title: Evolution Attribute Modifier
evolutionAttributeModifier.desc: Specifies a modifier value of the evolution rate attribute. The higher the value, the longer it takes for the Wither Storm to make a complete evolution (from phases 0 to 7), and vice versa. Cannot be lower than 0. Range: 0.01 ~ 32.0

farthestTargetingTime.title: Farthest Targeting Time
farthestTargetingTime.desc: Makes the Wither Storm target the player that was farthest from it while using FARTHEST targeting for the configured amount of time (in minutes). Range: 1 ~ 60

flamingSkullExplosionSize.title: Explosion Size
flamingSkullExplosionSize.desc: The flaming skull explosion size when they collide with blocks. Range: 1.0 ~ 16.0

flamingSkullSpeedModifier.title: Speed Modifier
flamingSkullSpeedModifier.desc: The speed modifier for flaming wither skulls. Higher = faster. Range: 0.5 ~ 8.0

flyingEnabledWarning.title: Flying Enabled Warning
flyingEnabledWarning.desc: Specifies if a warning should be printed out to server operators if flying is disabled.

flyingHeight.title: Flying Height
flyingHeight.desc: Specifies the height the Wither Storm will fly at during phase 4 and up. Range: 10 ~ 150

formidibombFuseEnabled.title: Fuse Enabled
formidibombFuseEnabled.desc: Specifies if a formidibomb's auto detonation fuse should be enabled.

headEscapeTime.title: Head Escape Time
headEscapeTime.desc: The targeting invulnerability time in seconds players who escape from a Wither Storm after injuring a head get. Range: 0 ~ 60

healFromChomp.title: Heal From Chomp
healFromChomp.desc: Specifies if the Wither Storm should heal whenever it eats a mob (determined by half the mob's max health).

healthScalePerPlayer.title: Health Scale Per Player
healthScalePerPlayer.desc: Adds this value multiplied by the amount of nearby players to the Symbiont's max health when it is spawned. Set to zero to disable this feature. Range: 0.0 ~ 100.0

hideDebrisRingsUntilSplit.title: Hide Debris Rings Until Split
hideDebrisRingsUntilSplit.desc: Hides the debris rings until the Wither Storm has split (phase 6).

hunchbackClusterPickupInterval.title: Hunchback Cluster Pickup Interval
hunchbackClusterPickupInterval.desc: Alters the interval (in ticks) of picking up block clusters for the hunchback phases (phase 0 - 3). NOTE: This value changes the evolution speed of the Wither Storm significantly. Range: 10 ~ 80

ignoreUltimateTargetIfHidden.title: Ignore Ultimate Target If Hidden
ignoreUltimateTargetIfHidden.desc: If the Wither Storm's ultimate target is hidden (bossbar is not visible for that target) for an extended period of time, it will ignore that target temporarily and go for a different player. Toggle to disable. NOTE: Only functional on a multiplayer environment.

increaseAmplifier.title: Increase Amplifier
increaseAmplifier.desc: Specifies if entities who are reinfected over a short period of time should receive wither sickness with a greater strength.

injectAiMobBlacklist.title: Inject AI Mob Blacklist
injectAiMobBlacklist.desc: A list of mobs that should not have custom AI injected into them

injectCustomAiBehavior.title: Inject Custom AI Behavior
injectCustomAiBehavior.desc: Specifies if custom AI behavior should be injected into certain entities (such as mobs running away from the Wither Storm). Disable if facing compatibility issues

instantChomp.title: Instant Chomp
instantChomp.desc: Specifies if a Wither Storm head should immediately kill the player upon biting them. Does not apply to heads inside the bowels.

invulnerabilityTime.title: Invulnerability Time
invulnerabilityTime.desc: Specifies the invulnerability time when the Wither Storm has been summoned, in seconds. When invulnerable, the Wither Storm doesn't move and can't be attacked. Range: 1 ~ 320

itemPreservation.title: Item Preservation
itemPreservation.desc: When a player dies, a block cluster containing their items will be created into the world based on the condition defined by this value. Acts as a gravestone.

keepSicknessAfterRespawn.title: Keep After Respawn
keepSicknessAfterRespawn.desc: Specifies if Wither Sickness should be removed after a player respawns.

lowImmuneApplicationDelay.title: LI Application Delay
lowImmuneApplicationDelay.desc: Specifies the amount of time in seconds low immunity mobs must be infected in order to be applied the wither sickness effect Range: 12 ~ 1200

lowImmuneApplicationModifierMax.title: LI Application Delay Modifier Max
lowImmuneApplicationModifierMax.desc: Low immunity mobs will be assigned a random application delay modifier that will change the proximity seconds time. This value will set the maximum potential limit for that modifier, in seconds. Range: 12 ~ 1200

lowImmuneCureDelay.title: LI Cure Delay
lowImmuneCureDelay.desc: Specifies the delay, in seconds, before low immunity mobs are cured of wither sickness Range: 12 ~ 1200

lowImmuneCureDelayModifierMax.title: LI Cure Delay Modifier Max
lowImmuneCureDelayModifierMax.desc: Low immunity mobs will be assigned a random cure delay modifier that will change the cure delay time. This value will set the maximum potential limit for that modifier, in seconds. Range: 12 ~ 1200

lowImmuneProximityModifierMax.title: LI Proximity Seconds Modifier Max
lowImmuneProximityModifierMax.desc: Low immunity mobs will be assigned a random proximity seconds delay modifier that will change the proximity seconds time. This value will set the maximum potential limit for that modifier, in seconds. Range: 12 ~ 1200

lowImmuneRequiredProximitySeconds.title: LI Required Proximity Seconds
lowImmuneRequiredProximitySeconds.desc: Specifies the amount of time in seconds that low immunity mobs must be near the Wither Storm in order to begin infection Range: 12 ~ 1200

lowResModels.title: Low Resolution Models
lowResModels.desc: Uses larger cubes to make up the the phase 4 and up models. May result in a performance increase.

lowerBlockResistance.title: Lower Block Resistance
lowerBlockResistance.desc: Lowers the resistance of blocks in the path of the explosion, effectively increasing the strength of the explosion which allows for obsidian, etc. to be destroyed.

maxRandomStrollTargetingTypeRadius.title: Max Random Stroll Targeting Type Radius
maxRandomStrollTargetingTypeRadius.desc: The max amount of distance a Wither Storm can travel at once when using the RANDOM_STROLL or RANDOM_STROLL_NEAR_PLAYER targeting type. Range: 200 ~ 5000

maximumDistractionDistance.title: Maximum Distraction Distance
maximumDistractionDistance.desc: Distractions will not occur if the Wither Storm's ultimate target is outside the radius determined by this value + its target range. Although, if the ultimate target is inside the radius, but then leaves, a distraction can then later occur. Range: 100 ~ 3000

maximumRoarInterval.title: Maximum Roar Interval
maximumRoarInterval.desc: Specifies the greatest time, in seconds, it will take for one of the Wither Storm's heads to initiate a roar and shoot a flaming skull. Range: 1 ~ 100

minimumDistractionDistance.title: Minimum Distraction Distance
minimumDistractionDistance.desc: Distractions will not occur IMMEDIATELY if the Wither Storm's ultimate target is INSIDE the radius determined by this value + its target range. If the target is inside this radius, the Wither Storm will wait before becoming distracted, to see if the target is outside the radius. If not, a distraction will not occur. Set to 0 to disable. Range: 10 ~ 500

minimumRoarInterval.title: Minimum Roar Interval
minimumRoarInterval.desc: Specifies the lowest time, in seconds, it will take for one of the Wither Storm's heads to initiate a roar and shoot a flaming skull. Range: 1 ~ 100

minimumSpawnCheckInterval.title: Minimum Spawn Check Interval
minimumSpawnCheckInterval.desc: Specifies the minimum interval (+random) in seconds that the Wither Storm should check for Withered Symbiont spawn conditions. Range: 1 ~ 240

minutesTillRunawayAttemptDiminish.title: Minutes Till Runaway Attempt Diminish
minutesTillRunawayAttemptDiminish.desc: Specifies the required time that must pass (in minutes) in order to decrease the runaway attempt amount. This timer only counts if the Wither Storms ultimate target remains in the stationary chunk radius. Range: 1 ~ 48

mobsRunIntoPortals.title: Mobs Run Into Portals
mobsRunIntoPortals.desc: Specifies if mobs should go into nearby nether portals when running away from a Wither Storm.

normalFlyingSpeed.title: Normal Flying Speed
normalFlyingSpeed.desc: Specifies a modifier value of Slow Flying Speed attribute. The higher the value, the faster the Wither Storm will go when it's ultimate target is not stationary Range: 0.01 ~ 1.0

occludeSoundsUnderground.title: Occlude Sounds Underground
occludeSoundsUnderground.desc: Specifies if sounds from the Wither Storm should be heard when deep underground.

onlyTryPickingUpTractorTagged.title: Only Try Picking Up Tractor Tagged
onlyTryPickingUpTractorTagged.desc: Makes the Wither Storm attempt to only grab blocks that were tagged in the Tractor Distractions json.

optifineWarning.title: OptiFine Warning
optifineWarning.desc: Toggles the OptiFine warning upon joining a world.

patronCosmetic.title: Patron Cosmetic
patronCosmetic.desc: Toggles the patron cosmetic for nonamecrackers2's Wither Storm backers.

phantomsOrbitWitherStorm.title: Phantoms Orbit Wither Storm
phantomsOrbitWitherStorm.desc: Specifies if phantoms AI should be overriden to allow circling above any nearby Wither Storms. Disable if you wish for default behaviour and/or if issues arise

playMinecraftMusic.title: Play Minecraft Music
playMinecraftMusic.desc: Specifies if Minecraft music should play at all. Used for if you want the boss music to play but not the Minecraft music.

playSymbiontTheme.title: Play Symbiont Theme
playSymbiontTheme.desc: Toggles the Withered Symbiont theme, created for CWSM by Mar Mar.

playWitherStormTheme.title: Play Wither Storm Theme
playWitherStormTheme.desc: Toggles the Wither Storm boss theme. NOTE: this theme is from MC:SM and is subject to copyright.

playerCannotDismountTentacles.title: Player Cannot Dismount Tentacles
playerCannotDismountTentacles.desc: Specifies if players should not be able to dismount a tentacle entity. Disable if facing compatibility issues.

playerInvulnerableTime.title: Player Invulnerable Time
playerInvulnerableTime.desc: Specifies the time in minutes (+random) that the players who killed a Withered Symbiont should be ignored by the Wither Storm for. Range: 1 ~ 10

playerSummoningDelay.title: Player Summoning Delay
playerSummoningDelay.desc: Specifies the delay in minutes (+random) that the Wither Storm should be able summon a Withered Symbiont for the player it summoned one for. Range: 1 ~ 60

playerSummoningDelayOnKill.title: Player Summoning Delay On Kill
playerSummoningDelayOnKill.desc: If a player kills a Withered Symbiont, their sumoning delay will be increased to this value in minutes (+random). Range: 1 ~ 60

preserveDropsForAllMobs.title: Preserve Drops For All Mobs
preserveDropsForAllMobs.desc: Specifies if drops should be preserved using block clusters (gravestones) for all mobs, not just players.

preventWitherStormCamping.title: Prevent Wither Storm Camping
preventWitherStormCamping.desc: Specifies if players should temporarily respawn away from the Wither Storm when they die to it, if their respawn point is near the Storm.

proximitySecondsModifierMax.title: Proximity Seconds Modifier Max
proximitySecondsModifierMax.desc: High immunity mobs (players) will be assigned a random proximity seconds modifier that will change the proximity seconds time. This value will set the maximum potential limit for that modifier, in seconds. Range: 12 ~ 1200

randomBowelsEntrance.title: Random Bowels Entrance
randomBowelsEntrance.desc: Specifies if players should spawn somewhere random when entering the bowels. Disable to revert to a static entrance position.

randomDistractionChances.title: Random Distraction Chances
randomDistractionChances.desc: Distractions may or may not occur if the conditions are met/unmet based off of a random chance. Toggle to enable/disable.

randomStrollingWhenTargetHidden.title: Random Strolling if Ultimate Target Hidden
randomStrollingWhenTargetHidden.desc: Specifies if the Wither Storm should stroll around the player if they're hidden from the storm.

randomizedTargetingTime.title: Randomized Targeting Time
randomizedTargetingTime.desc: If you're using RANDOMIZED targeting you can use this to set how often (in minutes) the Wither Storm should switch its targeting type. Range: 1 ~ 60

randomlySpeedUpWithTargetChange.title: Randomly Speed Up With Target Change
randomlySpeedUpWithTargetChange.desc: When set to true the Wither Storm will have a 10% chance to speedup when it changes it's targeting type while using RANDOMIZED targeting.

removeNearbyJunk.title: Remove Nearby Junk
removeNearbyJunk.desc: Specifies if junk items near the Wither Storm should be immediately destroyed. NOTE: Disabling will cause massive server side and potential FPS lag!.

renderDebrisCloud.title: Render Debris Particles
renderDebrisCloud.desc: Toggles the rendering of the debris cloud surrounding the Wither Storm.

renderDebrisRings.title: Render Debris Rings
renderDebrisRings.desc: Toggles the rendering of debris rings that surround the Wither Storm (much more performant than the debris cloud).

renderDistantDebris.title: Render Distant Debris
renderDistantDebris.desc: Setting this value to false will disable the debris cloud when rendering the Wither Storm from large distances.

renderEmissiveDecalForHeads.title: Render Emissive Decal For Heads
renderEmissiveDecalForHeads.desc: Specifies if the emissive decal (eyes and teeth) for the Wither Storm heads should be rendered.

renderPulse.title: Render Pulse
renderPulse.desc: Specifies if a pulsating effect, mimicking endermen pulling the Wither Storm apart, should be rendered once its evolution is complete.

renderShine.title: Render Shine
renderShine.desc: Specifies if a purple shine should render behind the Wither Storm at night.

renderSkyAmbienceEffects.title: Sky Ambience Effects
renderSkyAmbienceEffects.desc: Specifies if sky ambience affects (sky darkening) should render when a Wither Storm is nearby.

renderTractorBeamOverlay.title: Render Tractor Beam Overlay
renderTractorBeamOverlay.desc: Turn off to disable the overlay that appears when inside a tractor beam.

renderTractorBeams.title: Render Tractor Beams
renderTractorBeams.desc: Toggles the rendering of the tractor beams.

requiredContacts.title: Required Contacts
requiredContacts.desc: After a mob has been targetted by the Wither Storm a set maximum of times, the mob will become infected Range: 1 ~ 40

requiredProximitySeconds.title: Required Proximity Seconds
requiredProximitySeconds.desc: Specifies the amount of time in seconds high immunity mobs (players) must be near the Wither Storm in order to to begin infection Range: 12 ~ 1200

resummonedPhase.title: Withered Beacon Resummoned Phase
resummonedPhase.desc: Specifies the phase the Wither Storm should be set to when resummoned by a withered beacon. Range: 0 ~ 7

revivalPlayerProtection.title: Player Protection Time
revivalPlayerProtection.desc: Specifies the time (in minutes) after being revived that the Wither Storm should ignore players. Range: 1 ~ 40

revivalTimeMinutes.title: Revival Time
revivalTimeMinutes.desc: Specifies when (in minutes) the Wither Storm will automatically revive when playing dead. Range: 1 ~ 120

revivalTimer.title: Should Use Revival Timer
revivalTimer.desc: Specifies if the Wither Storm should automatically revive if not found after a period of time.

rotationSpeed.title: Rotation Speed
rotationSpeed.desc: Specifies the rotation speed of the Wither Storm. Range: 0.1 ~ 1.0

searchableRangeMultiplier.title: Search Range Multiplier
searchableRangeMultiplier.desc: Specifies the search radius multiplier for when searching for a random location to go to. Range: 1 ~ 8

shouldChaseWhenTargetStopped.title: Should Chase When Target Stopped
shouldChaseWhenTargetStopped.desc: If the ultimate target is stationary for a specific amount of time, the Wither Storm will begin to move towards it at a faster rate (chase). Toggle to enable/disable this feature.

shouldChunkLoadWhenNoPlayers.title: Should Chunk Load When No Players
shouldChunkLoadWhenNoPlayers.desc: Toggle to enable/disable Wither Storm chunk loading when no players are online.

shouldDropFromInventory.title: Should Drop From Inventory
shouldDropFromInventory.desc: Specifies if after a set amount of time the formidibomb item should drop out of whatever inventory is holding it and should spawn as the entity.

shouldPickUpVehicles.title: Should Pick Up Vehicles
shouldPickUpVehicles.desc: Specifies if the current entity the Wither Storm is picking up has a vehicle, that it should pick it up as well. Ex: Should pick up a player riding a boat.

shouldPlayGlobalSoundsCrossDimensionally.title: Global Sounds Cross Dimensionally
shouldPlayGlobalSoundsCrossDimensionally.desc: Specifies if global sounds made by the Wither Storm (e.x. evolve sound) should play cross dimensionally.

shouldShowHole.title: Should Show Hole
shouldShowHole.desc: Specifies if the bowels entrance hole in the Wither Storm's mass at the end of phase 7 should be available or not.

shouldSymbiontAttackMobs.title: Should Symbiont Attack Mobs
shouldSymbiontAttackMobs.desc: Specifies if the Withered Symbiont is hostile towards other mobs (This is only applied to Symbionts spawned after this change is applied).

sickenedMobConversions.title: Sickened Mob Conversions
sickenedMobConversions.desc: Specifies if mobs should convert to sickened mobs once they die from wither sickness.

smartBossbar.title: Smart Bossbar
smartBossbar.desc: The Wither Storm's bossbar and boss music will automatically toggle based on whether the player is underground or not. Disable to revert back to default bossbar/boss theme logic.

specialTargetingBias.title: Special Targeting Bias
specialTargetingBias.desc: Specifies if certain mobs (by default, players) should be targeted over others.

specialTargetingBiasChance.title: Special Targeting Bias Chance
specialTargetingBiasChance.desc: The percent chance certain mobs (by default, players) should be picked up over others. Range: 0 ~ 100

squashHitbox.title: Squash Hitbox
squashHitbox.desc: If true, the hitbox of the Wither Storm and Wither Storm Segment's will be shrunk vertically to one block. Enable if facing major server lag in the bigger Wither Storm phases

targetRunawayAttemptMinutes.title: Target Runaway Required Minutes
targetRunawayAttemptMinutes.desc: Specifies the required time, in minutes, the Wither Storms ultimate target must be stationary in order to be able to count a runaway attempt when it tries to leave the stationary chunk radius. Range: 1 ~ 20

targetRunawayAttempts.title: Count Target Runaway Attempts
targetRunawayAttempts.desc: Specifies if the Wither Storm should count the times its ultimate target leaves the stationary chunk radius. After a specified amount of attempts has been reached, the Wither Storm will accelerate to its Target Stationary Speed.

targetRunawayAttemptsRequired.title: Runaway Attempts Till Chase
targetRunawayAttemptsRequired.desc: Specifies the amount of runaway attempts made by the Wither Storms ultimate target that must be met for it to begin a chase. Range: 1 ~ 32

targetRunawayMinutes.title: Target Runaway Minutes
targetRunawayMinutes.desc: Specifies the amount of time in minutes that the Wither Storm's ultimate target has begun to run away in order to slow back down again. Range: 1 ~ 90

targetStationaryChunkRadius.title: Target Stationary Chunk Radius
targetStationaryChunkRadius.desc: If the player remains in a radius of chunks specified by this value for a specific amount of time, the Wither Storm will begin to move towards the player at a faster rate Range: 0 ~ 16

targetStationaryMinutes.title: Target Stationary Minutes
targetStationaryMinutes.desc: Specifies the amount of time in minutes that the Wither Storm's ultimate target must be stationary in order for it to accelerate Range: 1 ~ 120

targettingDistractionsEnabled.title: Can Be Distracted
targettingDistractionsEnabled.desc: Specifies when the Wither Storm is done chasing its ultimate target if it should become 'distracted' and go to a random nearby area.

tillShouldShowHole.title: Till Should Show Hole
tillShouldShowHole.desc: If the Wither Storm's ultimate target has a command block tool and the Wither Storm is at phase 7, a timer specified by this value (in minutes) + random will countdown until the hole will automatically appear. Range: 1 ~ 30

tractorBeamBlockSearchRadius.title: Tractor Beam Block Search Radius
tractorBeamBlockSearchRadius.desc: How far the tractor beams should search for distraction blocks, NOTE: High values may cause lag. Range: 4 ~ 256

tractorBeamClusterPickUp.title: Tractor Beam Cluster Pick Up
tractorBeamClusterPickUp.desc: Specifies if the Wither Storm should be able to pick up block clusters with its tractor beams.

tractorBeamClusterSpeedModifier.title: Tractor Beam Cluster Speed Modifier
tractorBeamClusterSpeedModifier.desc: Multiplies the speed of block clusters being pulled in by a Wither Storm's tractor beam by this value. Range: 0.1 ~ 10.0

tractorBeamFluidRemovalHeight.title: Tractor Beam Fluid Removal Height
tractorBeamFluidRemovalHeight.desc: Specifies the height of which tractor beams should remove water. The default of 63 is ocean height and upwards. Range: -64 ~ 320

tractorBeamParticles.title: Tractor Beam Particles
tractorBeamParticles.desc: Specifies if particles inside the tractor beams of the Wither Storm should render.

tractorBeamsRemoveFluids.title: Tractor Beams Remove Fluids
tractorBeamsRemoveFluids.desc: Makes it so the Wither Storm will remove fluids above Y 63 with its tractor beams.

tractorPullSpeedModifier.title: Tractor Pull Speed Modifier
tractorPullSpeedModifier.desc: Modifies the tractor beam pull speed, higher = faster. Range: 0.1 ~ 1.0

ultimateTargetingType.title: Ultimate Targeting Type
ultimateTargetingType.desc: Specifies the targeting type the Wither Storm should use to determine it's ultimate target.

usePhaseAsDistanceMultiplier.title: Use Phase As Distance Multiplier
usePhaseAsDistanceMultiplier.desc: Specifies if the Wither Storm should use the phase as a multiplier when calculating the time in ticks it takes for it to start accelerating, when its ultimate target is stationary.

vertexBufferRendering.title: Vertex Buffer Rendering
vertexBufferRendering.desc: Specifies if CWSM should use more performant rendering when rendering Block Clusters and the Wither Storm's mass. NOTE: It is not recommended to disable this option unless necessary.

witherSicknessEnabled.title: Enabled
witherSicknessEnabled.desc: Specifies if mobs should be able to receive wither sickness

witherSicknessLayer.title: Wither Sickness Layer
witherSicknessLayer.desc: Specifies if an overlay should be applied to entities that renders wither sickness

witherStormInvulnerability.title: Wither Storm Invulnerability
witherStormInvulnerability.desc: Specifies if the Wither Storm should regenerate its health and be melee attackable.

witherStormLOD.title: Wither Storm LOD
witherStormLOD.desc: Specifies if the low res models should be used when being rendered via the distant renderer.

witherStormSummoningDelay.title: Wither Storm Summoning Delay
witherStormSummoningDelay.desc: Specifies the delay in minutes (+random) that the Wither Storm will be able to summon a Withered Symbiont. Range: 1 ~ 20

witherStormsFollowBiggerStorms.title: Wither Storms Follow Bigger Storms
witherStormsFollowBiggerStorms.desc: Specifies if smaller Wither Storms should follow one with more consumed entities.
